They’re back and li’l’er than ever! UTA NATSUME returns with another batch of super-powered super-cuties to add some d’aww to your deck or collection. Do you know what feels better than casting game changing Planeswalkers? Casting game changing Planeswalkers that are just charming as all get-out. Act fast and grab these petite powerhouses before they leave forever!

• 1x Foil Borderless Elspeth, Sun’s Champion
• 1x Foil Borderless Narset, Parter of Veils
• 1x Foil Borderless Garruk Wildspeaker
• 1x Foil Borderless Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
• 1x Foil Borderless Sarkhan Vol
